intro.fr: Keroro RPG: Kishi to Musha to Densetsu no Kaizoku a un patch de traduction anglaise accompagné d'un randomizer optionnel.
intro.en: Keroro RPG: Kishi to Musha to Densetsu no Kaizoku has an English translation patch that comes with an optional randomizer.

text.fr: Le RPG Keroro sur Nintendo DS sort au Japon.
text.en: The Keroro RPG comes out on Nintendo DS in Japan.

text.fr: Dawnbomb publie sur Crystal Mods un patch qui traduit en anglais une grande partie des menus, accompagné d'un randomizer de sa conception.
text.en: Dawnbomb publishes a patch on Crystal Mods translating much of the menus into English, along with a randomizer of their own design.
